t: A desktop robot arm with add-on kits for vision, drawing, and laser engraving.
steps: Find the ultraArm on the Elephant Robotics site.
Ask the vendor for current prices and models.
Download the control software from the vendor site.
Ask IT to approve the software.
Set up the arm on a stable table.
Run the arm with a simple movement program.
Add a drawing or vision kit after the basics work.
